hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The cost of a continuous range is defined by the difference between its extreme values, max - min.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: As the right pointer advances, the range of valid left endpoints moves monotonically to the right.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Track the maximum and minimum elements using two double-ended queues to evaluate validity in amortized constant time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element is inserted and removed from the double-ended queues at most once, running in O(n) overall.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
